content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-66. - Administrative procedures; legal counsel.
content.summary:
(a)
Administrative procedures.
The authority may adopt administrative procedures, rules, and policies as necessary
               or convenient to implement the provisions of this chapter of the Code and Colorado
               Liquor Code in accordance with chapter 2 of this Code.
(b)
Legal counsel…

faqs.a:
(a)
Administrative procedures.
The authority may adopt administrative procedures, rules, and policies as necessary
               or convenient to implement the provisions of this chapter of the Code and Colorado
               Liquor Code in accordance with chapter 2 of this Code.
(b)
Legal counsel.
The city attorney or designee thereof shall be the legal advisor to the authority
               and shall serve as prosecutor for violations of this Code or Colorado Liquor Code.
               In the event of a conflict, the city attorney may appoint outside legal counsel.
(
Ord. No. 4872
, § 2, 4-15-2024)
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4872
, § 2, adopted April 15, 2024, repealed the former § 6-66, and enacted a new § 6-66
               as set out herein. The former § 6-66 pertained to removal of members; vacancies and
               derived from
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018.
